How to play

  1. Tap the hamster to earn coins. With a keyboard, focus it and press Space or Enter.
  2. Buy a stronger tap for +1 base coin per tap, or an auto-tapper for +1 base coin per second.
  3. Each coin multiplier adds 1× to all earnings. At 2×, both your taps and auto-tappers earn twice as much.
  4. Upgrades stack, and each purchase raises that upgrade’s next price. Keep growing at your own pace.

Coins are just for fun. Progress stays in this page’s memory and resets on refresh. No account needed.
